_comment: Do not put the active config in the skill directory.
The active config is machine-local and may contain guest credentials.
Never commit it and always redact secrets from model output.
Host paths are shared by all targets.
setup-host.ps1 fills paths found by bounded probing or an elevated process check.
Add one object per VM. Bind its observed VirtualKD kd_pipe explicitly.
Every target also needs a unique mcp_pipe for the WinDbg MCP bridge.
The baseline must be saved after the guest booted and WinDbg attached successfully.
